We need to determine crimes. Facts: selling obscene audio-visual products (淫秽音像制品). In Chinese criminal law, distributing, selling, or manufacturing obscene materials is a crime of "传播淫秽信息罪" (Crime of disseminating obscene information). Also possibly "非法出版、复制、发行淫秽出版物罪". Under Criminal Law article 363? Actually article 363: "制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽书刊、影片、音像制品的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "传播淫秽信息罪"? The statutory name is "传播淫秽信息罪" (disseminating obscene information). But also "非法出版、复制、发行淫秽出版物罪". Which is correct? The law uses "制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽书刊、影片、音像制品的" as a single offense, named "传播淫秽信息罪"? Actually the crime is "传播淫秽信息罪" (Article 363). The term "淫秽出版物" is also used. The statutory offense name is "传播淫秽信息罪". The rule: output only statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So we output "传播淫秽信息". Also need to consider if there are multiple crimes: selling (贩卖) and also maybe "非法经营罪"? No. The act is selling obscene CDs. So only one crime.

Thus final answer: [罪名]传播淫秽信息<eoa>
